name: Sentry webhooks
description: Lets a webhook channel take Sentry's issue, uptime and alert events.
author: Seti

channelSources.title: Sentry
channelSources.description: Integration platform webhooks: issues (uptime included), issue and metric alerts.
channelSources.setup: In Sentry, set the URL as the webhook URL of an internal integration and turn on the issue and alert events. Sentry signs with Sentry-Hook-Signature, using the client secret it issues.
